intro: The Escape is an escort quest in the northern Barrens where adventurers help the goblin pilot Wizzlecrank flee the Venture Company's drill site at the Sludge Fen. Trapped inside a stolen prototype shredder, Wizzlecrank requires protection against waves of company mercenaries until he clears the industrial pit. The mission concludes by reporting back to his contact, Sputtervalve, in the port town of Ratchet.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I suppose I'll learn as we go... Couldn't be too hard. Just some buttons here, and a lever or two... Well, are you ready to go?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hopefully we'll be able to get something of value from the wrecked shredder prototype... My time's running out! I'll dispatch a salvage team to Wizzlecrank's location on the double.
Oh, let me give you something for your trouble, too.
